_설명: 천일문 3권 워크북 Chapter 07 비교 표현의 Chapter Test를 변형한 것. 심화 8과 비교구문 자리에 합쳐 둔다.

points.point: 비교급 강조: much, even, still, far, a lot (very 불가)

questions.prompt: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 알맞은 것을 고르세요.
body: The train travels ________ than the bus.

choices.text: fast
fastest
faster
more fast
the fastest

questions.prompt: 다음 중 밑줄 친 단어와 바꿔 쓸 수 없는 것을 고르세요.
body: The new stadium is [[much]] larger than the old one.

choices.text: even
a lot
far
very
still

questions.prompt: 다음 표를 보고 주어진 단어를 사용하여 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰세요.
questions.answer: (1) as sweet as  (2) not as[so] expensive as

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: My sister is getting stronger and stronger.
He looks twice as old as his actual age.
Walking to school is a lot healthier than take a bus.
It snowed three times as much as the previous winter.
The more you read, the more ideas you will get.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 어법상 알맞지 않은 문장을 고르세요.

choices.text: No one can sing as well as Mina in our class.
My dad made my sandwich as big as possible.
This gallery has the most expensive painting in the country.
No other building is as taller as the city tower in my town.
The Amazon is one of the longest rivers in the world.

questions.point_label: as와 as 사이에는 비교급을 쓰지 않는다
questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The autumn concert was not as [[more exciting]] as the summer show.

questions.prompt: 다음 문장에서 밑줄 친 부분을 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The actor’s movie was [[the funniest]] than other actors’ movies.

questions.prompt: 다음 주어진 문장과 같은 의미의 문장을 고르세요.
body: Jiho’s plan was more practical than mine.

choices.text: My plan was as practical as Jiho’s.
My plan was not practical as Jiho’s.
My plan was not so practical as Jiho’s.
Jiho’s plan was not as practical as mine.
Jiho’s plan was as practical as mine.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: The more you practice, the little nervous you’ll feel.

questions.prompt: 다음 글에서 어법상 알맞지 않은 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰세요.
body: One of the greatest inventors are Thomas Edison.

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 영어로 바르게 옮긴 것을 고르세요.
body: 날씨가 더 추워질수록, 더 많은 사람들이 코트를 입는다.

choices.text: Colder the weather gets, more people wear coats.
The colder the weather gets, more people wear coats.
The cold the weather gets, the more people wear coats.
The colder the weather gets, the more people wear coats.
The coldest the weather gets, the most people wear coats.

questions.prompt: 우리말과 일치하도록 주어진 단어를 사용하여 문장을 완성하세요.
body: 기차가 평소보다 훨씬 더 일찍 출발했다. (early, leave, the train, much, usual, than)
questions.answer: The train left much earlier than usual

questions.prompt: 다음 중 주어진 우리말을 영작한 것으로 알맞지 않은 것을 고르세요.

choices.text: 나는 소라만큼 기타를 잘 치고 싶다. → I want to play the guitar as well as Sora does.
미세먼지는 매일 점점 더 나빠지고 있다. → The fine dust is getting more and more bad every day.
미나의 중간고사 성적은 모든 학생들 중 최고의 성적이었다. → Mina’s midterm score was the best score of all the students.
지호는 아기를 깨우지 않기 위해 가능한 한 조용히 문을 닫았다. → Jiho closed the door as quietly as possible not to wake the baby.
바다가 더 따뜻해질수록, 태풍이 더 강해질 것이다. → The warmer the sea becomes, the stronger the typhoons will be.

questions.prompt: 짝지어진 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것을 모두 고르세요.

choices.text: Sora’s foot is as small as a child’s. = Sora’s foot is smaller than a child’s.
He studies harder than any other student. = He studies the hardest of the students.
Effort is as important as talent to me. = Talent is less important than effort to me.
As the days get shorter, more people feel tired. = The shorter the days get, the more people feel tired.
Mina is the most popular singer among teenagers. = No other singer is more popular than Mina among teenagers.
